harper: FYI i'm wrapping up a docs PR that unifies the streaming SDK snippets (py/ts/go). adds a tiny 'resume shim' pattern and fixes the streaming migration link. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/980

noah: nice. does the shim assume deterministic server resume or is it purely client-side idempotency? need a one-liner in the caption explaining that retries only safe if server supports deterministic resume or operation is idempotent.

sasha: for Go example please show context cancellation during backoff and an error type that exposes the resume token. otherwise callers won't be able to persist token. i'll upload a small patch.

riley: there was a stale link in the migration guide pointing to /docs/streaming-old; good that PR updates to /docs/streaming-resume. can we add a 3-item migration checklist? (token storage, idempotency, token retention TTL)

devdocs-bot: CI: docs build passed for PR #980 (:white_check_mark:)

harper: thanks — i'll merge after sasha's go tweak and a 1-line idempotency note from noah. short and focused.
